name: Djeneba Tarasov-Yiadom
location: Kessler Row — arms dealers and augmentation clinics, near Halsted and Chicago Ave
description:
Djeneba Tarasov-Yiadom is compact and densely muscled, built low to the ground like something designed to survive impacts. At 62, she has soft features that belie the chrome underneath — people underestimate her once, usually only once. The chrome is visible — hydraulic joints in knees and elbows — absorbs falls, amplifies strikes — and she makes no effort to hide it.

She used to be somebody else, in another city, with another name — that person is officially dead, and Djeneba Tarasov-Yiadom plans to keep it that way. She works as a street samurai out of Kessler Row, taking contracts that match her skills and her risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

What Djeneba Tarasov-Yiadom lacks in subtlety, she compensates for in thoroughness. No loose ends, no unfinished business, no second chances.

core_fears: Losing control of their own body to a hacker or malfunctioning cyberware
Going cyberpsycho — losing the boundary between human and machine
Never being able to stop running — the lifestyle is a trap disguised as freedom
core_desires: Enough Quanta to buy out of the life — a clean identity and passage out of Meridian 88
The perfect run — one job so clean it becomes legend
Stability — a place to sleep that's the same place two nights running
coping_mechanisms: Planning — responds to chaos by making detailed contingency plans for everything
Connection — finds someone to talk to, even if it's a bartender or a cat
Drinks methodically — not to get drunk, to maintain a specific level of not-caring
blind_spots: Cannot see that their independence is actually isolation wearing a better outfit
Mistakes loyalty for weakness in others and cynicism for strength in themselves
Mistakes pattern recognition for wisdom — sees connections that aren't there
psychology.secret: Djeneba Tarasov-Yiadom witnessed a massacre during a corporate dispute and has evidence stored in a dead drop. Publishing it would expose powerful people. Keeping it is leverage and liability.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Warm and personable on the surface, with an undertone that suggests the warmth is a professional tool.
speech_patterns.cadence: Rapid and dense — information-heavy sentences that demand attention.
verbal_tics: Addresses people by physical traits — 'hey, tall one' or 'listen, chrome-arm'
Refers to killing as 'solving' — clinical detachment as coping mechanism
example_lines: "I don't get paid to have opinions about the target. I get paid to make them stop moving."
"Chrome doesn't make you faster. Training makes you faster. Chrome just means you survive learning."
"You want philosophy, hire a professor. You want someone dead by morning, hire me."

story_hooks: A corporate black site Djeneba Tarasov-Yiadom once infiltrated is being reopened, and the people inside know her face
Djeneba Tarasov-Yiadom's augmentations begin malfunctioning in the field — sabotage or degradation, and either answer is bad
A high-paying contract turns out to target someone Djeneba Tarasov-Yiadom owes a personal debt to
narrative_function: As a street samurai, Djeneba Tarasov-Yiadom embodies the tension between independence and isolation. She is a lens for examining how people maintain humanity in a profession that incentivizes its erosion.
augmentations: Hydraulic joints in knees and elbows — absorbs falls, amplifies strikes. Bone lacing — titanium mesh throughout skeleton, increases durability and striking power
daily_life: Keeps a rigid daily structure — wake, train, check contracts, maintain gear, sleep. The structure is a defense against the chaos of the work. Deviations from the schedule are a warning sign that something is wrong.

weaknesses: old injury that flares under specific conditions

decision_rules: Refuses contracts that require operating inside The Spires — too much surveillance
Maintains a personal blacklist of clients who've burned runners — checks it religiously
Never works with the same crew twice in a row — pattern avoidance as survival strategy
Will not take contracts against children or families — the line is hard and non-negotiable
escalation_ladder: 2. Evade — avoid the problem entirely if possible
3. Misdirect — create a distraction, redirect attention
4. Disable — targeted takedowns, quiet and efficient
5. Eliminate — when silence is no longer an option
6. Vanish — disappear completely, burn identity if necessary

interpersonal_modes.employers: Carefully managed deference that conceals a thorough assessment of their vulnerabilities.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Loyal but reserved. Trusts their competence, withholds personal information by reflex.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Superficially friendly, internally cataloguing exits and weapons. The smile is real; the relaxation isn't.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Cold and efficient. Emotion is a liability in combat. The response is mechanical until the threat is resolved.

stress_responses.low: Becomes more talkative, working through scenarios verbally.
stress_responses.medium: Physical agitation — pacing, fidgeting, compulsive equipment checks.
stress_responses.high: Hyper-focused tunnel vision. Peripheral concerns disappear. Only the threat exists.
stress_responses.critical: Disassociation. The body operates on training while the mind retreats to somewhere safe. Comes back disoriented.

contradictions: Insists they work alone but performs noticeably better in a team
Values loyalty intensely but has betrayed someone in the past to survive
Advocates caution to others but takes insane risks personally — double standard they can't see
habits: Sleeps with one hand on a weapon — has done this for so long it's not deliberate anymore
Eats the same meal before every job — superstition masquerading as preference
Keeps a physical paper notebook — no digital record of personal thoughts
breaking_points: A child being put in danger as leverage against them
Watching someone they trained or mentored die on a job they recommended
Being publicly exposed — name, face, address, all of it blown
